deals.postCaption: NYC Restaurant Week (@nycrestaurantweek) — or month as it has become — is scheduled during traditionally slow times of the winter and summer. Yet this current one, which runs through mid-August, falls in the midst of an incredibly epic New York City summer unlike any other. So if you've skipped the biannual event in the past, this is a good year not to — and there are real deals to be had. Eater Northeast lead editor Melissa McCart (@melissamccart) poured over the hundreds of specials and highlighted some of the best deals to be had, from Brooklyn landmark steakhouse Gage & Tollner (@gage.and.tollner) to Chelsea restaurant Markette (@marketterestaurant) for its exciting peri peri chicken.
